title: About Quillwood Gardens — the people who look after your garden
description: Meet the small team behind Quillwood Gardens, and see some of the courtyards, backyards and beds we have designed and planted.

sections.heading: A small team that knows Sydney gardens
sections.body: We started Quillwood to make gardens that suit the people who use them, and the climate they grow in.

image.alt: A sandy path winding between shrubs and flowers

sections.heading: How we work
sections.body:
Every garden starts with a visit. We walk it with you, ask how you use it, and look at the soil, the light and what already grows well.

Then we draw a plan, choose plants that suit, and either plant it for you or hand it over for you to build at your own pace.
